items.source: An implementation of the given interface that also implements MapId.
items.translation: 实现了给定接口，同时也实现了MapId的接口实现。

items.source: Produces an implementation of the given id interface type using the type's class loader. For restrictions on id interfaces definitions, see IdInterfaceValidator.validate(Class). Returns an implementation of the given interface that also implements MapId, so it can be cast as such if necessary.
items.translation: 使用给定 id 接口类型的类加载器生成该接口的实现。有关 id 接口定义的限制，请参阅 IdInterfaceValidator.validate(Class)。返回一个实现了给定接口的实现类，该类同时也实现了 MapId，因此必要时可将其强制转换为该类型。

items.source: Produces an implementation of the given class loader. For restrictions on id interfaces definitions, see IdInterfaceValidator.validate(Class). Returns an implementation of the given interface that also implements MapId, so it can be cast as such if necessary.
items.translation: 生成给定类加载器的实现。有关 ID 接口定义的限制，请参阅 IdInterfaceValidator.validate(Class)。返回给定接口的一个实现，该实现同时也实现了MapId，因此必要时可以将其转换为该类型。

items.source: Factory class for producing implementations of given id interfaces. For restrictions on id interfaces definitions, see IdInterfaceValidator.validate(Class).
items.translation: 用于生成给定 ID 接口实现的工厂类。有关 ID 接口定义的限制，请参阅IdInterfaceValidator.validate(Class)。

items.source: Produces an implementation of the given id interface type using the type's class loader.
items.translation: 使用给定 ID 接口类型的类加载器生成该类型的具体实现。

items.source: Produces an implementation of the given class loader.
items.translation: 生成给定类加载器的实现。
